банкомат: a machine in the wall that gives you cash
банківський рахунок: a place in a bank where your money is kept
бути без грошей: to have no money at all
бути винним (гроші), заборгувати: to need to pay money back to someone
бюджет: a plan of how much money you can spend
вигідна покупка: something you bought for a very good price
гаманець: a small case for money and cards
грабіж (завищена ціна): something that costs far too much
зарплата: money you get for your work, usually monthly
зняти гроші: to take money out of your bank account
каса: the place in a shop where you pay
монети: small round pieces of metal money
обмінний курс: how much one currency is worth in another
оренда, орендна плата: money you pay every month to live in a home
переказ: sending money from one account to another
платити частинами: to pay a little at a time
повернути (товар): to take something back to the shop
податки: money you must pay to the government
позичати (в когось): to take something that you will give back later
позичати (комусь): to give something that will be given back to you later
порівнювати ціни: to look at prices in different places
рахунок (до сплати): a paper that says how much you must pay
решта; дрібні гроші: money you get back; also small coins
розмір: how big clothes or shoes are
того вартий: good enough to justify the cost or effort
цінник: a small label that shows the price
іпотека: a big loan to buy a house
